# runpod_registry_delegations (Data Source)

All AWS ECR pull delegations owned by the authenticated account. Replaces the 1.x runpod_ecr_delegations data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "runpod_registry_delegations" "all" {}

output "delegated_repositories" {
  description = "Registry URI each delegated ECR repository resolves through."
  value = {
    for d in data.runpod_registry_delegations.all.delegations :
    "${d.repository}:${d.tag}" => d.docker_registry_uri
  }
}

output "aws_principals_to_authorize" {
  description = "AWS principals Runpod pulls as, per region; grant each read access on its repository."
  value       = toset([for d in data.runpod_registry_delegations.all.delegations : "${d.aws_user} (${d.aws_region})"])
}
```

Complete, runnable configurations that use this data source live in the
use-case modules under `v2/modules/` in the provider repository; the Guides
section documents each one.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `delegations` (Attributes List) One entry per ECR delegation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--delegations))

<a id="nestedatt--delegations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `delegations`

Read-Only:

- `aws_region` (String) AWS region of the delegated ECR repository.
- `aws_user` (String) AWS principal Runpod pulls as; grant it read access on the repository.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp in RFC 3339 format.
- `delegator_user_id` (String) Runpod user that created the delegation.
- `docker_registry_uri` (String) Registry URI to pull the image from, for a Docker login.
- `id` (String) Delegation identifier.
- `name` (String) Human-readable delegation name; null when the delegation was created without one.
- `repository` (String) ECR repository name parsed from the delegated ARN.
- `tag` (String) Image tag the delegation covers.
